You see a camp box.
You set this down. It stays here, with whatever is in it. You can take it up again, or hand it over and leave it for good.
How to use: To take it up, move it, name this camp or hand it over, press C beside it. Pack up camp takes up every kit of yours within 4 cells in one action. Open it from its menu to put things in or take them out (it takes up to 12 separate things; a stack counts as one).
Cost and limits: Taking it up keeps its contents and fuel. Handing it over leaves it standing, and you can no longer take it up.
Right now you can: take up, hand over (you can no longer take it up), pack up camp (5 things), move and 1 more.

sections.text:
In your pack, cut one spare plain, unworn armor into a cured leather offcut.
